Copyright (C) 2016 The R Foundation for Statistical Computing
Platform: x86_64-apple-darwin13.4.0 (64-bit)

My Xtools is 8.2.1

My command line tools are installed

$ gcc --version

Configured with: --prefix=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/usr --with-gxx-include-dir=/usr/include/c++/4.2.1

Apple LLVM version 8.0.0 (clang-800.0.42.1)

Target: x86_64-apple-darwin16.4.0

Thread model: posix

InstalledDir: /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer/Toolchains/XcodeDefault.xctoolchain/usr/bin


I have seen this error on some forums, but I have not found a solution. I have tried reinstalling R and R studio. That didn't work.


Best,


Clay

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Re: Rstan and C++ problem
parts:
On Wednesday, February 1, 2017 at 4:47:53 PM UTC-5, Clayton Webb wrote:

I must admit, there places in the directions that are a little hard for me to follow. If find the directions about the "Make" file posted at https://cran.r-project.org/doc/manuals/r-release/R-admin.html#Customizing-package-compilation particularly hard to follow. Are these commands I run in R or commands I use in terminal?

I agree, that documentation from CRAN is hard to follow. Your Makevars file looks ok to me, except how the heck did "names(mtcars)" get in there? There's also unnecessary duplicated lines in there but I don't think that's a problem. Although I doubt this will fix the problem you're having it's probably a good idea to recreate your Makevars file. To keep the essentials but get rid of "names(mtcars)" and the duplicate stuff try this: 

cat("\nCXXFLAGS=-O3 -mtune=native -march=native -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unused-function -Wno-macro-redefined",
    file =  file.path(Sys.getenv("HOME"), ".R", "Makevars"), sep = "\n", append = FALSE)

That will at least give you a Makevars file that isn't potentially problematic but if that doesn't resolve the problem (and I doubt it will) then hopefully Ben will have another idea about what's going wrong. 

Jonah

messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: Rstan and C++ problem
parts:
Ok so it seems that it really was just that it couldn't handle the "names(mtcars)" thing (the duplicate lines shouldn't have been a problem). The Makevars file just contains compilation instructions and you pretty much never need to touch it again after finishing the installation process. I'm really not sure how yours got messed up like that if you only modified it using the code from the RStan installation instructions. That's very strange. It's quite possible that it was already messed up due to something totally unrelated before you tried to install RStan but I don't know what that would be. 

Jonah
